description: Administrative interface for managing organizational hierarchy and partner tree structure. Allows viewing, editing, and organizing partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format.

pages.name: PartnerTreeComponent
pages.description: This page provides the administrative interface for managing your organization's hierarchy and partner tree structure. You can view, edit, and organize partner categories and groups in a hierarchical tree format, allowing for clear visualization and management of your business relationships.

buttons.label: New Partner Level
buttons.description: This button opens a dialog to create a new organizational node, such as a category, group, or level, within the partner hierarchy tree. This allows you to expand and define new segments of your organizational structure.
when_to_use: When you need to add new organizational categories, groups, or levels to the partner tree structure.
When you are setting up a new segment of your business hierarchy.
When you want to define a new reporting line or classification within your partners.

search.description: Currently, there are no specific search capabilities defined for this page. You will need to navigate the tree manually.
search.help_text: To find specific items, you may need to expand nodes and visually locate them.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, remember that the main view is a hierarchical tree. Use the expand/collapse icons (usually arrows or plus/minus signs) next to each node to reveal or hide its sub-levels. To add a new top-level item or a sub-level, click the 'New Partner Level' button. To modify an existing item, simply click on its row in the tree. If you need to reorder items, look for drag-and-drop indicators.
common_tasks: Creating partner levels: Click the 'New Partner Level' button located at the top of the page to open the creation dialog. Fill in the required details and save to add a new organizational node.

Editing partner structure: Click on any existing tree node (row) in the main display area. This action will typically open an edit dialog or panel where you can modify the organizational details of that specific partner level.

Managing hierarchy: To organize partner categories and groups, you can often drag and drop nodes within the tree to change their parent-child relationships. Look for visual cues indicating drag-and-drop functionality.

Viewing organizational structure: Use the expand (usually a plus sign or right arrow) and collapse (minus sign or down arrow) icons next to each node to navigate and explore different levels of the hierarchy.

Administrative management: This page allows you to configure organizational relationships and reporting structures by defining and arranging partner levels. Ensure all mandatory fields are completed when creating or editing.
troubleshooting: Problem: Cannot find a specific partner level → Solution: Expand all parent nodes to reveal hidden sub-levels, or manually scroll through the tree. If the item is very deep, consider if it was created under an unexpected parent.
Problem: 'New Partner Level' button is disabled → Solution: This usually indicates you lack the necessary permissions to create new levels. Contact your administrator for access.

Problem: Changes are not saving → Solution: Ensure all mandatory fields are filled out correctly. Look for validation errors highlighted on the form. If the issue persists, refresh the page and try again.
help_guidance.getting_started: Welcome to the Partner Tree management page! Your first step is to understand the existing hierarchy by expanding and collapsing nodes. To add your first new partner level, click the 'New Partner Level' button. Fill in the name and type, then save. You can then click on this new level to edit its details or drag it to place it under another parent if needed.
keyboard_shortcuts: Tab: Navigate between interactive elements on the page.
Enter: Activate a selected button or open an edit dialog for a selected tree node.
